'''''Euphorbia anachoreta''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Euphorbiaceae]], endemic to the [[Fora Islet]] of the [[Savage Islands]].<ref name="iucn status"></ref> This species has been considered a [[Critically Endangered species]] due to its highly restricted population size.<ref name="iucn status"></ref> As most other succulent members of the genus ''Euphorbia'', its trade is regulated under Appendix II of [[CITES]].<ref name="Species+">{{Cite web |title=Species+|url=https://speciesplus.net/species#/taxon_concepts/27159/legal |access-date=7 February 2023}}</ref>

In the wild, it grows in the crags of basaltic rocks, where it is sheltered from salty winds.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Molero |first1=J. |last2=Rovira |first2=A.M. |title=A note on the taxonomy of the Macaronesian ''Euphorbia obtusifolia'' complex (Euphorbiaceae) |journal=Taxon |date=1998 |volume=47 |issue=2 |pages=321–332|doi=10.2307/1223761 |jstor=1223761 }}</ref>
